headline: Citizens demonstrate demanding dismissal of Attorney General Emiliano Rolón - National - ABC Color
summary: Citizens protested in central Asunción demanding the removal of Attorney General Emiliano Rolón over the slow response to complaints against the intervened Ueno Bank. An impeachment motion has 16 signatures in the Chamber of Deputies.
why: Ueno Bank is a Paraguayan lender under government intervention, and prosecutorial handling of related complaints bears on confidence in the country's banking sector.
